title: NFC Keyboard Emulator server config
description: Server connection settings for NFC Keyboard Emulator, imported as a file or through an nfc-keyboard-emulator://configure?config=<base64url(JSON)> link. Every key except format and version is optional: an absent key leaves that setting unchanged, and an explicit empty string clears it. Unknown keys are ignored.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Ignored by the app.

deviceName.description: Name sent with every message so stations can be told apart. The app trims surrounding whitespace. An absent key leaves the name unchanged; an empty string clears it, which means the OS host name.

enabled.description: Send every scan to the URL.

url.description: Empty, or a well-formed absolute URL. The scheme must be lowercase http or https and a host is required. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating. An absent key leaves the setting unchanged; an empty string clears it.

token.description: Sent according to auth; by default as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Only visible ASCII characters (no spaces, control characters or non-ASCII), since the token can go into an HTTP header. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating. An absent key leaves the token unchanged; an empty string clears it.

auth.description: How the token is sent to the HTTP endpoint. Only the field of the active mode is checked; the others are kept so switching modes loses nothing. An absent key keeps the current setting; a present object replaces it, and its missing keys take their defaults. Older app versions ignore it.

mode.description: bearer sends Authorization: Bearer <token>. header sends the token as the value of the header named by headerName. basic sends Authorization: Basic with username and token as the password. query appends the token to the URL as the query parameter named by queryParam. none sends no credential.

headerName.description: Header that carries the token in header mode. An RFC 7230 token (letters, digits and !#$%&'*+-.^_`|~) that is not Host, Content-Length, Content-Type, Connection, Upgrade, Transfer-Encoding or Sec-WebSocket-*. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating.

username.description: User name in basic mode. May be empty. Visible ASCII without a colon. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating.

queryParam.description: Query parameter that carries the token in query mode. Letters, digits and . _ ~ - only, not empty. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating.

payload.description: What a scan looks like when sent to the HTTP endpoint with every POST. An absent key keeps the current setting; a present object replaces it, and its missing keys take their defaults. Older app versions ignore it.

mode.description: standard sends the app's own JSON. template sends the JSON in template instead.

template.description: JSON text, at most 8192 bytes in UTF-8, used in template mode and kept otherwise. Placeholders of the form {{name}} are replaced inside string values (never keys): uid, uidFormatted, uidLength, scanId, device, reader and timestamp. A string that is exactly {{uidLength}} becomes a number. Not trimmed. The app rejects a template that is not valid JSON, is too large or names an unknown placeholder.

ws.description: WebSocket settings, shared by stream and request mode.

url.description: Empty, or a well-formed absolute URL. The scheme must be lowercase ws or wss and a host is required. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating. An absent key leaves the setting unchanged; an empty string clears it.

token.description: Sent according to auth on the upgrade request; by default as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Only visible ASCII characters (no spaces, control characters or non-ASCII), since the token can go into an HTTP header. The app trims surrounding whitespace before validating. An absent key leaves the token unchanged; an empty string clears it.

An absent key keeps the current setting; a present object replaces it, and its missing keys take their defaults. Older app versions ignore it.

stream.description: Send every scan over the WebSocket.

request.description: Answer scan requests sent by the server.
